summary: Comprehensive testing of Solana Sniper Bot mobile app completed. All backend APIs (21/21 tests) passed successfully. Frontend loads correctly with all 5 tabs functional. Dashboard controls, wallet config, scanner, portfolio, and logs all working as expected. Data integration between backend and frontend verified.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead (non-critical)
Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (non-critical)

react_native_issues.issue: Text-based tab clicks don't work reliably in Expo web preview. Coordinate-based clicks work correctly. This is a testing limitation, not an app bug.

action_items: Consider updating shadow* style props to boxShadow in future iterations (low priority)
Package version updates available: expo-linear-gradient (55.0.12 -> ~15.0.8), react-native-svg (15.15.4 -> 15.12.1) - optional
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ MongoDB ObjectId handling: All endpoints correctly exclude _id from responses
✅ Environment variables: Backend uses MONGO_URL and DB_NAME correctly from .env
✅ Frontend API calls: All use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly
✅ Async/await: All database operations use async/await properly
✅ testID attributes: All interactive elements have testID for testing
✅ React Native components: Proper use of View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet
✅ Error handling: API endpoints return appropriate status codes and error messages
✅ Data persistence: All CRUD operations verified with GET requests after mutations
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. App uses existing data from previous curl commands (private key, RPC URL already saved). Bot state is running with simulated token detections and positions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs and frontend features are working correctly. The app is fully functional with proper data integration. Tab navigation in Playwright tests requires coordinate-based clicks due to Expo web preview limitations. Backend tests require EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to be exported before running pytest. Two test files created: test_sniper_bot_api.py (16 tests) and test_wallet_config.py (5 tests).
rca_of_issue: N/A - No critical issues found. All features working as expected.
